name: 测试驱动修复（TDD）
description_zh: 当 bug 有清晰、廉价的测试路径时，先写一个会失败的回归测试，再去改生产代码；测试不划算（需重 harness、脆mock、端到端慢）就跳过，改用最接近的验证。
description_en: Use only when the user explicitly asks for TDD, a failing test, or a regression test, OR when the bug has an obvious cheap local test target. Skip when the test path is unclear, expensive, integration-heavy, or not requested.
